data.one_liner: Parse string colors into Flutter Color objects
data.what_it_does: Pigment provides a simple API to convert hex, rgb, and CSS color names into Flutter Color instances. It extends the Color class so all Color methods are available.
use_when: You need to use string literals for colors in your UI
You want quick conversion of CSS named colors
You want a lightweight dependency for color parsing
avoid_when: You need advanced color manipulation or theming engines
You require a full-featured color picker widget
strengths: Supports hex, rgb, and CSS names
Extends Color for full API access
data.setup_notes: Add pigment to pubspec.yaml and import package:pigment/pigment.dart
